solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: See boss, cunning man on board

definitions.note: a see is a bishop's diocese; the boss of an archbishop's see is the archbishop

parts.note: arch means cunning or roguish, as in an arch look
a bishop is a chess piece, a man on the chessboard

explanation.surface: An instruction to go and see a crafty fellow who works aboard a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb and 'board' like a ship's deck; here a see is a diocese and the board is a chessboard.
explanation.definitionFit: An archbishop presides over an archdiocese, the principal see of a church province.

clue.text: Bar 40 cutting a drug

indicators.note: cutting means slicing into, so forty goes inside the other letters

parts.note: E is ecstasy, a common crossword drug
XL is 40 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A bar where forty people cut a drug.
explanation.definitionFit: An axle is a rod or bar on which wheels turn.

clue.text: Commend appeal among Anglicans

indicators.note: among puts one piece in the midst of the other

parts.note: CE is the Church of England, the Anglican church
it is slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Praising an appeal made among the members of the Church of England.
explanation.definitionFit: To cite someone is to mention them officially for praise, as in a military citation.

clue.text: It's required to take off planks around middle of garden

parts.note: boarding is a structure of planks
ca, short for circa, means around

indicators.note: middle of takes the central letters of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Instructions for stripping planks from around the centre of a garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take off' looks like removing the planks; here it is an aircraft leaving the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A boarding card is the pass a passenger must show to get on a plane before departure.

clue.text: Commandeer four-by-four across the Channel

definitions.meaning: to take over by force, to commandeer
four times four is sixteen, which is ... in French, the language over the English Channel

explanation.walkthrough: 'four-by-four' looks like an off-road car, an apt thing to commandeer; it is four times four.
explanation.definitionFit: Commandeering is taking possession by force, which is seizing.

clue.text: Lasted longer than guy getting exposed all round

indicators.note: all round means one word encloses the other

parts.note: outed means exposed publicly
a guy is a rope or stay that steadies a tent or mast

explanation.surface: A man exposed on all sides outlasted the rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guy' looks like a man; it is a guy rope, also called a stay.
explanation.definitionFit: To outstay is to remain longer than others, so to outlast them.

clue.text: Duty, and where it often lies?

definitions.meaning: a duty lies ..., read as two words

explanation.surface: A musing on responsibility and where it tends to fall.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as ON US: duties are often said to lie on us.
explanation.definitionFit: Onus is a burden of obligation, a formal word for responsibility.

clue.text: Stole time with new gift from Cupid on leisure craft

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed above, so this part comes first

parts.note: Cupid's arrows make people fall in love
a boa is a long scarf or stole

explanation.surface: Someone stole time and a love token while aboard a pleasure boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stole' looks like a verb; it is a scarf. In a down clue 'on' puts the first half above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrowboat is a long canal boat, now mostly used for holidays and leisure.

clue.text: Main bit on the side short of one sewer

parts.note: the main is the open sea

indicators.note: short of means lacking, so one letter is taken out

parts.note: a bit on the side is a lover outside marriage, a mistress
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A main drain section running along the side, one short of a sewer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sewer' looks like a drain; it is one who sews.
explanation.definitionFit: A seamstress is a woman who sews for a living, literally a sewer.

clue.text: Opera and short story about artist going through reserves

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the shortened tale is read backwards
short means the story loses its final letter

parts.note: a tale is a story
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist
via means by way of, going through
TA is the Territorial Army, the British Army's reserve force

explanation.surface: Comparing an opera and a tale about a painter passing through reserve forces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims TALE to TAL and 'about' turns it to LAT.
explanation.definitionFit: La Traviata is Verdi's 1853 opera about the courtesan Violetta.

clue.text: Zone dealing with stopping motorists

indicators.note: stopping means plugging a gap, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, the British motoring organisation
re means about or concerning, dealing with

explanation.surface: A zone set up for pulling motorists over.
explanation.definitionFit: An area is a region or district, the same idea as a zone.

clue.text: Kate's excited sailors with English dish

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: a tar is a sailor, and two tars make TARTAR

explanation.surface: Kate gets the sailors excited by serving an English dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excited' rearranges KATES to STEAK.
explanation.definitionFit: Steak tartare is a dish of raw minced beef, served with egg and capers.

clue.text: Unplanned tuition saved following reorganisation

indicators.note: after a reorganisation things are in a new order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Money saved on tuition by accident after a school restructure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following reorganisation' is the anagram signal, not a sequence word.
explanation.definitionFit: Adventitious means arising by chance rather than design, so happening without a plan.

clue.text: Duke brought food in fenland city, and rightly so

indicators.note: in places the food-serving word within the city

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in the Fens of Cambridgeshire
served means brought food to the table

explanation.surface: A duke served dinner in a fenland city, and quite right too.
explanation.walkthrough: ELY is a small city in the Fens, the flat marshland of eastern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Deservedly means justly, as merited, which is rightly so.

clue.text: What bad plan needs to do with emaciated monarch

parts.note: re means about, to do with
emaciated means very thin
a king is a monarch

explanation.surface: A bad plan needs sorting out, involving a starving king.
explanation.definitionFit: A poor plan calls for reconsideration, a fresh look at the scheme.

clue.text: Times sign has gone from outside for good

indicators.note: has gone says the sign is no longer there, so it is removed

parts.note: externally means from outside
x is the multiplication or 'times' sign

explanation.surface: A sign at The Times newspaper has been taken down from the exterior permanently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper, but it is multiplication: its sign X goes from EXTERNALLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternally means forever, and something gone for good is gone permanently.

clue.text: Oil jars built with care

indicators.note: jars means jolts or shakes, so the letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Oil jars that have been carefully made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jars' looks like containers for the oil; it is a verb meaning shakes up, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To oil a machine is to lubricate it, reducing friction between moving parts.

clue.text: Walker has left out warning signal

indicators.note: out means missing, so the letter for left is removed

parts.note: an ambler is someone who walks at a leisurely pace

explanation.surface: A rambler has abandoned a warning sign on the trail.
explanation.definitionFit: Amber is the traffic light that warns drivers the lights are about to change.

clue.text: Principle of the complex integrated circuit

indicators.note: complex means intricate or tangled, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: The design principle behind a complicated microchip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complex' rearranges THE to ETH.
explanation.definitionFit: An ethic is a moral principle that guides conduct.

clue.text: They're lined up in hospital firm briefly in county

indicators.note: in places the shortened firm word within the county

parts.note: Beds is the short form of Bedfordshire, an English county

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: steady means firm or stable

explanation.surface: Things arranged in rows on a ward, linked to a company in an English county.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' cuts STEADY to STEAD; BEDS is Bedfordshire, a county north of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Bedsteads are bed frames, which stand in rows along a hospital ward.

clue.text: Plonk racket in Riviera on ground

indicators.note: in puts the noise word inside the rearranged letters
ground means crushed and broken up, so these letters are reworked

parts.note: a din is a racket, a loud noise

explanation.surface: Someone sets down a tennis racket on the floor on the French Riviera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plonk' looks like a verb about putting down the racket; it is British slang for cheap wine. 'ground' rearranges RIVIERA ON, and DIN goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Vin ordinaire is cheap everyday table wine, which British slang calls plonk.

clue.text: A northern beast upended joint

indicators.note: upended means turned upside down, which in a down entry reads the word backwards

parts.note: an elk is a large deer, a beast

explanation.surface: A northern animal turned over, hurting a joint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upended' turns ELK to KLE.
explanation.definitionFit: The ankle is the joint between foot and leg.

clue.text: She finishes programme with a somersault

indicators.note: a somersault turns head over heels, so these letters are reversed
finishes points to the closing letters of the word programme

explanation.surface: A gymnast ends her show with a somersault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finishes' takes AMME, the end of programme, and 'with a somersault' turns it over to give the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Emma is a woman's name, so she is a female person, as Jane Austen's heroine.

clue.text: Eager to promote name that's not far from 21

indicators.note: to promote is to raise, so in a down entry the letter for name moves higher

parts.note: keen means eager

explanation.surface: An eager man keen to advance his own name.
explanation.walkthrough: 21 is ANKLE, a few inches down the leg.
explanation.definitionFit: The knee is the leg joint just above the ankle, so they are close neighbours.

clue.text: On which to stand cut flower belonging to Welshman?

indicators.note: cut means trimmed, so the flower loses its last letter

parts.note: a daisy is a flower

explanation.surface: A cut flower owned by a man from Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'belonging to Welshman?' is a second hint: DAI is a typical Welsh name, so DAI'S means belonging to him.
explanation.definitionFit: A dais is a raised platform on which a speaker stands.

clue.text: Suppliers of pork and game

definitions.meaning: back and gammon are both cuts of pig that supply pork
a board game played with dice

explanation.surface: A butcher's line about providers of pork and game meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'game' looks like venison and the like; it is the board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Backgammon is a dice and counters board game, so it is one kind of game.

clue.text: You often get aches at the start — practising this?

definitions.text: You often get aches at the start — practising this?

indicators.note: at the start points to the opening letter of each of those four words

explanation.surface: A warning that beginners at a stretching discipline tend to ache.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoga is a stretching and posture discipline whose newcomers commonly feel sore muscles.

clue.text: Slow European chopped vegetable in time

indicators.note: in places the European and the chopped vegetable inside the time word

parts.note: a date is a point in time

indicators.note: chopped means cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: celery is a vegetable

explanation.surface: A slow European chopping vegetables in time to music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chopped' cuts CELERY to CELER.
explanation.definitionFit: To decelerate is to reduce speed, which is to slow down.
